snippet.title: Star Fox EH - Talan Incident - Level 1
snippet.description:
A playthrough of the first Talan Incident level featuring Miyu and Fay! It serves as the first level of a brand new campaign based on Star Fox 2.
A  new version of the game featuring this level is out now, you can download it via knossosnet: https://knossoslauncher.com/
If you would like to support this project, check out our Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/starfoxeh
